        buildtype: [ 'release' ]

    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}

    env:

      is_upload: ${{(github.repository == 'strawberrymusicplayer/strawberry' || (github.repository == 'strawberrymusicplayer/strawberry-private' && matrix.runner == 'macos-intel')) && (github.event_name == 'release' || (github.event_name == 'push' && github.event.pull_request.head.repo.fork == false && (github.ref == 'refs/heads/master' || github.ref == 'refs/heads/ci' || github.ref == 'refs/heads/macos')))}}

    steps:

      - name: Set arch
        shell: bash
        run: echo "arch=$(uname -m)" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Set buildtype
        run: echo "buildtype=$(echo ${{matrix.buildtype}} | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Set cmake buildtype
        run: echo "cmake_buildtype=$(echo ${{env.buildtype}} | awk '{print toupper(substr($0,0,1))tolower(substr($0,2))}')" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Uninstall homebrew
        if: env.is_private != 'true'
        run: |
          curl -sfLO https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Homebrew/install/master/uninstall.sh
          chmod +x ./uninstall.sh
          sudo ./uninstall.sh --force
          rm -f uninstall.sh

      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          submodules: recursive

      - name: Import certificate file

          p12-file-base64: ${{ secrets.APPLE_DEVELOPER_ID_CERTIFICATE }}
          p12-password: ${{ secrets.APPLE_DEVELOPER_ID_CERTIFICATE_PASSWORD }}

      - name: Unlock keychain
        if: env.is_private == 'true'
        run: security unlock-keychain -p ${{ secrets.MACOS_KEYCHAIN_PASSWORD }}

      - name: Download macOS dependencies
        if: env.is_private != 'true'
        run: curl -f -O -L "https://github.com/strawberrymusicplayer/strawberry-macos-dependencies$(test "${{env.arch}}" = "x86_64" && echo -n "-legacy" || echo -n "")/releases/latest/download/strawberry-macos-${{env.arch}}-${{env.buildtype}}.tar.xz"

      - name: Extract macOS dependencies

        run: sudo tar -C / -xf strawberry-macos-${{env.arch}}-${{env.buildtype}}.tar.xz

      - name: Set prefix path
        run: echo "prefix_path=/opt/strawberry_macos_${{env.arch}}_${{env.buildtype}}" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Update PATH
        run: echo "${{env.prefix_path}}/bin" >> $GITHUB_PATH

      - name: Set MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET
        shell: bash
        run: |
          # Use the deployment target Qt was built with, which is the minimum macOS version supported by the Qt version.
          qtcore=
          for file in "${{env.prefix_path}}/lib/QtCore.framework/QtCore" "${{env.prefix_path}}/lib/libQt6Core.dylib"; do
            if [ -f "${file}" ]; then
              qtcore="${file}"
              break
            fi
          done
          if [ "${qtcore}" = "" ]; then
            echo "Could not find QtCore in ${{env.prefix_path}}/lib."
            exit 1
          fi
          deployment_target=$(otool -l "${qtcore}" | awk '/LC_BUILD_VERSION/ { b = 1 } /LC_VERSION_MIN_MACOSX/ { v = 1 } !found && ((b && $1 == "minos") || (v && $1 == "version")) { print $2; found = 1 }')
          if [ "${deployment_target}" = "" ]; then
            echo "Could not get the deployment target from ${qtcore}."
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET: ${deployment_target}"
          echo "MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET=${deployment_target}" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Create Build Environment
        run: cmake -E make_directory build

      - name: Configure CMake
        env:
          PKG_CONFIG_PATH: ${{env.prefix_path}}/lib/pkgconfig

        run: >
          cmake --log-level="DEBUG" -S . -B build
          -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE="${{env.cmake_buildtype}}"
          -DCMAKE_PREFIX_PATH="${{env.prefix_path}}/lib/cmake"
          -DBUILD_WERROR=ON
          -DUSE_BUNDLE=ON
          -DICU_ROOT="${{env.prefix_path}}"
          -DAPPLE_DEVELOPER_ID=$( (test '${{env.is_private}}' = 'true' || (test '${{github.repository}}' = 'strawberrymusicplayer/strawberry' && test '${{github.event.pull_request.base.repo.full_name}}' = '${{github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name}}')) && echo "383J84DVB6" || echo "")
          -DENABLE_SPOTIFY=$(test -f "${{env.prefix_path}}/lib/gstreamer-1.0/libgstspotify.dylib" && echo "ON" || echo "OFF")
          -DENABLE_SPARKLE=ON
          -DENABLE_QTSPARKLE=OFF
          -DDMG_NAME=$(test '${{matrix.runner}}' = 'macos-intel' && echo "strawberry-compat" || echo "strawberry")
          -DCREATE_SOURCE_API_CREDENTIALS=OFF
          -DAPI_CREDENTIALS_ENCRYPTION_KEY="$(openssl rand -hex 32)"
          -DACOUSTID_API_KEY="${{secrets.ACOUSTID_API_KEY}}"
          -DLASTFM_API_KEY="${{secrets.LASTFM_API_KEY}}"
          -DLASTFM_SHARED_SECRET="${{secrets.LASTFM_SHARED_SECRET}}"
          -DLISTENBRAINZ_CLIENT_ID="${{secrets.LISTENBRAINZ_CLIENT_ID}}"
          -DLISTENBRAINZ_CLIENT_SECRET="${{secrets.LISTENBRAINZ_CLIENT_SECRET}}"
          -DSPOTIFY_CLIENT_ID="${{secrets.SPOTIFY_CLIENT_ID}}"

          -DGENIUS_CLIENT_ID="${{secrets.GENIUS_CLIENT_ID}}"
          -DGENIUS_CLIENT_SECRET="${{secrets.GENIUS_CLIENT_SECRET}}"
          -DMUSIXMATCH_APP_ID="${{secrets.MUSIXMATCH_APP_ID}}"
          -DMUSIXMATCH_APP_SECRET="${{secrets.MUSIXMATCH_APP_SECRET}}"
          -DOPENTIDAL_CLIENT_ID="${{secrets.OPENTIDAL_CLIENT_ID}}"
          -DOPENTIDAL_CLIENT_SECRET="${{secrets.OPENTIDAL_CLIENT_SECRET}}"
          -DDISCOGS_CLIENT_ID="${{secrets.DISCOGS_CLIENT_ID}}"
          -DDISCOGS_CLIENT_SECRET="${{secrets.DISCOGS_CLIENT_SECRET}}"
          -DTIDAL_CLIENT_ID="${{secrets.TIDAL_CLIENT_ID}}"

      - name: Build
        run: cmake --build build --config Release --parallel 4

      - name: Build tests
        run: cmake --build build --config Release --target build_tests --parallel 4

      - name: Run tests
        env:
          QT_QPA_PLATFORM: offscreen
        run: ctest --test-dir build --build-config Release --output-on-failure

      - name: Install
        working-directory: build
        run: make install

      - name: Deploy
        working-directory: build
        run: make deploy

      - name: Verify code-signing
        if: env.is_private == 'true' || (github.repository == 'strawberrymusicplayer/strawberry' && github.event.pull_request.head.repo.fork == false)
        working-directory: build
        run: codesign --deep -v strawberry.app

      - name: Create DMG

      - name: Store notarization credentials

      - name: Notarize DMG
        if: env.is_private == 'true' || env.is_public_release == 'true'
        working-directory: build
        run: xcrun notarytool submit *.dmg --keychain-profile "strawberry-notarization" --wait

        if: env.is_private == 'true' || env.is_public_release == 'true'

      - name: Create checksum
        if: steps.set-upload-path.outputs.upload_path != ''
        working-directory: build
        run: for i in *.dmg; do shasum -a 256 "${i}" > "${i}.sha256sum"; done
